pr.title: Remove 47 economy forwarding methods
pr.body:
## Summary

Call the existing farming, shop, production and equipment implementations directly, removing 47 private Economy forwarding methods and the empty field-planning partial. The existing public gates, checks, typed ports, selected plans and shared implementations remain in place. Cart-planning comments move to the shared transport methods.

## Type of change

- [x] Refactor or tooling

## Scope and related work

- Author: Codex session 33837055
- Refs #2552. Partial cleanup; further supported Economy reduction remains.
- Existing behavior: mechanical forwarding removal, preserving bound targets, arguments, defaults, out parameters and state owners.
- Other open PRs that overlap: #2788 (11 paths: separate staging/definition/constant changes), #2787 (3 caller adapters: InventoryExecution, FieldOrders and TreePlantingOrders; its receiver/base changes will need preserving when resolving the same caller lines), #2784 (7 caller paths: different Runtime/Orders forwarding removals). None supplies required code or is duplicated. All nine open file maps were checked.
- Stacked on: none; based on main 835f9db1155bfb03fb741b2d5bcde9de50031316.
- Lines added and removed: source +102/-253 = 151 net removed across 46 files; tests/docs 0. Seven comment lines are preserved at their shared implementations.
- Work left: #2552 remains partial; no whole-area exhaustion claim. Reflection-used methods and calls with unsupported argument effects remain.
- Needs a hands-on check after merge: no new player behavior; none added.
- Draft waits for: all exact-head CI gates. Local validation is complete.

## Checks

- Baseline locked Simulation Release: passed, 0 warnings/errors.
- Formatted candidate Simulation Release: passed, 0 warnings/errors (50.01s).
- Preview semantic compilation: 47 removed methods, 96 call replacements, 3,586 preserved call/member bindings; six allocating ports checked as pure adapters, cached farming port retained. Market receiver follows the existing pure Towns getter.
- Actual formatted source: all 1,030 remaining simulation files match the validated preview token streams; empty partial absent.
- Checked in game by hand: not performed.
- Full dependent locked Release build: passed, 0 warnings/errors (123.95s), including Server, Godot client and test assembly.
- Existing focused tests: 513/513 cases, 186 actual methods, 40 classes (35 whole and 5 partial); no failures/skips. Separate 482-case and 31-case TRXs reconcile exactly to the selected identities.
- Native equivalence: all 68 frames match checkpoint bytes, events and observation digests, with clean base/head checkouts.
- Compiled inventory: exactly 47 method bodies removed (50,166 to 50,119); Root fields and generated capture inventory preserved; full/test/native DLL and PDB copies match. Generated ordinal numbers are normalized.
- Format verification, diff checks and stale-text search pass. CI Verify 40020040697 is pending; this remains a draft. Its actual checkout is 0609a4c4e19bc2fdeaa98186f1a0111278532631 (head into base 835f9db1).

## Saves and replay

- [x] Saved world state, events and replay behavior are unchanged.

No fields, schemas, public interfaces, events or saved records change. Native equivalence passed for the clean exact base and head.

## Writing, docs and changelog

- [x] No game text changed.
- [x] No public docs are affected by private forwarding removal.
- Stale-text search: all 45 distinct removed method names and FieldPlanning file name searched. One how-it-works.md paragraph still accurately describes the retained shared FarmingSystem methods; no false sentence found.
- [x] No changelog entry is required for an internal refactor with no changed player behavior.
